positions.title: Solutions Engineer Innovation Lab Intern
positions.description:
- Built & provided the entire sales organization with a standardized library of assets pertaining to demos, workshops, POV's, etc. Accelerated our transition from creating assets from a case-to-case basis to a standard medium.
- Developed a web application to demonstrate Vault's Transit Secrets Engine. More specifically, encryption of user authentication data. Built with HTML, CSS, JS for front-end. Node.js, Bash, MongoDB, Vault for back-end.
- Ensured smooth transition from a local to a production-ready enviroment.
- Deployed application through learning platform, Instruqt. This can be used by customers, and even employees to gain exposure to how the Transit Engine works. Located here: https://play.instruqt.com/hashicorp/invite/hmj7qt7z825d 
- Swiftly delivered project within 1 1/2 months.
- Exceeded expectations and not only worked on, but delivered another project during the remainder of my internship. Project detailed different presentation frameworks and ranked them based on certain categories.
positions.insights: Skills: Teamwork · Front-End Development · Back-End Web Development · Encryption · NoSQL · Vault

positions.title: CEO & Co-Founder
positions.description:
- Successfully started up Wrath proxies, providing B2C SaaS solutions on wholesale software goods that we purchased and resold to individual customers.
- While navigating the pandemic, grossed over $200K+ in revenue.
- Trained a team of two W2 employees, and empowered them to respond to customer's requests within the same hour of initial customer interaction.

positions.title: Business Development Manager
positions.description:
- Wrathbots LLC delivered customers a software solution in obtaining highly-anticipated streetwear.
- Assisted in creating massive social media growth, accumulating over 110,000+ followers on all platforms. 
  - X account - https://x.com/wrathbots
- Actively listen to customers' requests, confirming full understanding before addressing concerns.

positions.title: Co-Owner
positions.description:
- Built from the ground up, netted a $60K+ profit over the span of 4 months.
- Provided B2B solutions through software for retail product monitoring to check if a retail item's back in stock/out of stock.
- Utilized the popular social application, Discord, in order to send these notifications.

volunteerExperiences.description:
- Led and coached U12 boys soccer team
- Organized practices and games to help young athletes develop their skills
- Mentored players to become better team players and individuals
- Demonstrated strong leadership skills and effective communication
- Motivated players to reach their full potential and created a positive team environment
- Worked closely with parents to keep them informed of their child's progress and to encourage their support and involvement in team activities
- Built strong relationships with families to ensure the success of the team as a whole
- Volunteered time and expertise to give back to the community
- Honed coaching skills and made a positive impact on the lives of young athletes.
